verdict.rationale: Auth0 Actions are documented as versioned, tenant-specific Node.js functions that run automatically inside login and identity flows, and they replace the older Rules and Hooks. Shared code across Actions is supported, Actions can be deployed by AI agents through the official MCP server, and the overview describes event-driven responses such as breach notification and blocking suspicious IPs. Missing for 10: an enumerated list of supported trigger events beyond login/identity flows, in-depth docs on rule/trigger configuration, independent hands-on corroboration.
